{{Top|leg}}
The '''Carbonite Miners' Union''' was a union of [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] [[Mining/Legends|miners]] in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] in the years leading up to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. The head of the union was [[Farng]].

==Behind the scenes==
Its relation to the [[Carbonite Guild]] is unknown.
